name: Andy Bacon
bio: Former software prototyper at Apple on Vision Pro, and co-creator of DAVIGO, a finalist for VR Game of the Year at the 2024 Steam Awards.

name: Kassy Krahn
bio: 3D artist specializing in dioramas and props, previously at Next Level Games on Luigi's Mansion 3.

name: Adrian Talens
bio: Sound designer and composer with a special interest in VR. His Poly Bridge soundtrack was featured in PC Gamer's article "Listen to the best game music of the year".
